backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: IWM, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock leadership, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The IWM breadth-thrust leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: IWM breadth thrust with SPY/QQQ confirmation may identify broad participation before the next session fully reprices stock leaders.

2_history_check.exp-20260502-001: IWM-vs-SPY breadth confirmation inside accepted risk-on SPY-relative leader sizing failed; this tests a standalone default-off candidate source, not core sizing.
2_history_check.exp-20260530-005: FINRA + IWM confirmation was accepted, indicating IWM can be useful when paired with an independent source. This run lacks FINRA and must prove the breadth-thrust stock source alone.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-016: QQQ/IWM risk-appetite tech laggard repair failed; this tests leaders across the sector-known broad universe, not tech laggards.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-019: VIXY volatility-relief leadership was accepted; this is a different cross-asset state and must not reuse VIXY thresholds.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: IWM breadth-thrust days where IWM leads SPY while SPY and QQQ also close firm may identify liquid stock leaders whose next-open 10-day paper continuation adds cleaner replacement value than generic broad momentum.
interpretation: The IWM breadth-thrust stock-leadership source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning IWM/SPY/QQQ thresholds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that IWM breadth thrust is still a broad beta/momentum relabel, arrives too late for next-open single-stock continuation after costs, or clusters in weak old_thin drawdown states.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping IWM return, IWM-vs-SPY, IWM-vs-QQQ, SPY/QQQ confirmation, stock close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT breadth evidence, such as actual advance/decline participation, options/borrow structure, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source failed to add robust replacement value after next-open entry and costs. That suggests IWM breadth thrust did not reliably separate durable stock leadership from generic risk-on beta in the canonical windows.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter exposing the same IWM/SPY/QQQ breadth-thrust context, broad-market sector-known liquid stock universe, leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
